evals.title: Low-friction capture with no silent loss
evals.recommended_next_move: Route every capture to a normalized source or bounded research task.

evals.title: Source normalization and retrieval state
evals.recommended_next_move: Normalize retrieved sources and create retrieval tasks for inaccessible candidates.

evals.title: Atomic observations preserve source affordances
evals.recommended_next_move: Decompose each integrated source into located, limited observations.

evals.title: Independent epistemic, publication, and selection states
evals.recommended_next_move: Hold any projection whose epistemic, publication, or selection state is not ready.

evals.title: Promotion requires an auditable evidence path
evals.recommended_next_move: Connect confirmed claims through observations and keep unearned projections held.

evals.title: Collective credit and calibrated causality
evidence: apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/development-records.ts — CLM-NYCAC-CABARET-REPEAL-CONTRIBUTION-CANDIDATE names Jamie's specific actions while explicitly preserving credit for Council Member Rafael Espinal, partner organizations, other advocates, the Council, and the Mayor.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/nycac-research-2026-07-14.ts — OBS-TNR-COUNCIL-JAMIE-TESTIMONY, CLM-NYCAC-MARCH-TRANSPARENCY-LAW, and CLM-NYCAC-MARCH-REPLACED-BY-CURE keep Jamie's testimony, coalition advocacy, Council enactment, and later City action distinct; individual causality and disbandment claims are expressly rejected.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/campaign-press.ts — CLM-NYCAC-CAMPAIGN-PRESS-CORPUS is dormant and held; metadata observations support no claims, and RT-NYCAC-CAMPAIGN-PRESS-CLOSE-READING requires article-level review, collaborator credit, and causal triangulation before promotion.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/development-records.ts — CLM-WATERWAYS-GREAT-ACCOMMODATIONS-PROGRAM and CLM-OPEN-HOUSE-PARTICIPATORY-DESIGN preserve Suzanne Hogan, housemate, participant, and communal-governance credit while still naming Jamie's spearheading, initiating, tending, and facilitation actions.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/fixtures/campaign-press-capture-inventory.json and CLM-NYCAC-CAMPAIGN-PRESS-CORPUS reproduce 45 ordered placements as 44 article identities, with SRC-NYCAC-NPR-KUAF-CABARET-2017-09-20 explicitly retained as the sole cross-campaign duplicate; the integrity tests passed 8/8.
evals.recommended_next_move: No material issue forces another iteration for KD-006. Continue article-level close reading without relaxing the existing credit and causality boundaries.

evals.title: Research queue covers unresolved value and public claim gaps
evals.recommended_next_move: Give every unresolved high-value lead and inference claim a prioritized task.

evals.title: Projection is purposeful and reversible
evals.recommended_next_move: Keep developed claims dormant or held until a purpose-specific surface selects approved wording.

evals.title: Provenance graph and correction history remain traversable
evals.recommended_next_move: Repair broken references and ensure each integrated capture has a traversable path.

evals.title: Public-repository safety and citational care
evals.recommended_next_move: Remove unsafe payloads and satisfy canonical citation validation.

evals.title: Photo-editor feedback loop creates questions, not automatic proof
evals.recommended_next_move: Document the claim-to-brief and discovery-to-research loop with rights and corroboration gates.

evals.title: Source-backed strength through Chad's lens
evidence: apps/www/src/content/work/fair-rent-nyc.mdx — the reader-facing projection names strong direct actions through CLM-NYCAC-COFOUNDER-ROLE-CANDIDATE, CLM-NYCAC-CABARET-REPEAL-CONTRIBUTION-CANDIDATE, and CLM-NYCAC-TALKS-NOT-RAIDS-TESTIMONY, then explains what the documentation and civic infrastructure made usable.

apps/www/src/data/proofs.ts and apps/www/src/data/work.ts — nyc-artist-coalition-public-web-infrastructure, nyc-artist-coalition-civic-systems, and fair-rent-campaign-memory make co-founding, website construction, public testimony, source mapping, and stewardship of 30+ pages legible without attributing collective policy outcomes to Jamie.

docs/knowledge-bank/promotion-slate.md — selected claims have explicit hiring-site purposes; CLM-NYCAC-OFFICE-CREATION-CONTRIBUTION-CANDIDATE and CLM-NYCAC-FIREGUARD-PASS-RATE-ATTESTED remain prioritized for research, while CLM-NYCAC-CAMPAIGN-PRESS-CORPUS remains knowledge depth rather than current-site copy.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/campaign-press.ts and docs/knowledge-bank/projects/nyc-artist-coalition-press.md — the 45-placement/44-identity corpus is treated only as a reproducible bibliography and future research field, never as accomplishment evidence.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/records.ts — the /work/fair-rent-nyc occurrence map purposefully selects seven bounded claims and their source sets while excluding the unread press corpus from the reader-facing surface.
evals.recommended_next_move: No material issue forces another iteration for KD-012. Preserve the purposeful current selection and promote only proposition-level results that mature through RT-NYCAC-CAMPAIGN-PRESS-CLOSE-READING.
